ideas.title: Investigating the ICE Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the ICE shooting and the subsequent investigation, including the untruthful statements made by ICE officers.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
What motivated the ICE officers to make untruthful statements?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger scandal within ICE and the potential for a cover-up. It requires careful investigation and analysis of the evidence.
